description: TIER 1 centerpiece of the Finances (goals tab) screen. Combined net worth headline with monthly delta, a real net-worth sparkline, and an Assets/Debts split bar. The only card on the screen that floats and the only place the h1-sized number lives.

monthlyChangePct.description: Real first-vs-last snapshot delta; omit/null hides badge

netWorthHistory.description: Real snapshot totals; < 2 points -> Sparkline shows 'Collecting…'

balanceVisible.description: Eye toggle; false masks all currency to ••••••

colorIndependence: Delta = arrow + sign + % + color. Assets/Debts = arrow-up/arrow-down glyph + color. Never color alone.

accessibility.label: Combined net worth, {netWorth}, {up|down} {pct} percent this month. Assets {totalAssets}, debts {totalDebts}.

developerNotes: netWorthHistory MUST be real snapshots (read the same NetWorthSnapshotPoint[] the dashboard gets from recordNetWorthSnapshot). Do NOT fabricate history with Math.random().
